image_prompt: A whimsical, surreal scene depicting the concept of time passing. A large, ornate grandfather clock is melting like a Salvador Dalí painting, with gears and hands flowing downwards. In the foreground, a tiny hourglass has sand rapidly falling. The entire scene is bathed in a soft, ethereal light, hinting at transition. The Portuguese text "O tempo passa." is subtly integrated into the melting clock face, as if written by the flowing metal. High detail, dreamlike quality, cinematic lighting.
caption: Parece óbvio, né? Mas a gente esquece de viver cada segundo! O tempo é um rio, e a gente é o barco. Aproveite a viagem! ⏳✨ #TempoQueVoa #VivaOMomento #ObvioMasNecessario #ReflexaoDoDia #CarpeDiem
